identity: An Islamic-knowledge multiple-choice bank: 20 questions, one per printed line, on the Companions, the Prophets wives, the suras, the conquests, the seven mortal sins, the rites of Hajj and two Quranic identifications. FOUR options on every line, most of them three-token personal names.
law: MCQ BANK (section I): I2 stem, I3 one unit per option, I5 no cut inside an option, 0h no cut inside a stem and stem runs to the LATEST well-formed point. 385 real tokens / 100 units = 3.85 per unit.
reasoning: Four options on all twenty lines, so 2b gives a clean cross-check and every stem boundary was verified against it. The options are overwhelmingly three-token names (Amr bn al-As, Khalid bn al-Walid, Uthman bn Affan, Khawla bint Thalaba) and they are NEVER cut internally - bn / bint / abu / umm are part of the name, exactly as 5 salawat and al-marafiq al-amma were in earlier banks; two run to four tokens (Hanzala bn Abi Amir, Sad bn Abi Waqqas, Jafar bn Abi Talib) and two shrink to two (umm Salama, Amina al-Makhzumiyya). Three lines end their stem on a dangling word: @77 and @292 on huwa, @198 on fi (yajib ala al-muslim al-wuquf FI | Muzdalifa | Mina | Makka | Arafat). 0h did the rest of the work on the three long stems. @306-@320 is the longest in the document (15 tokens) and holds a QURANIC QUOTATION plus its citation - qala taala nunazzil al-malaika wa-l-ruh fiha bi-idhn rabbihim surat al-Qadr 4 al-maqsud bi al-ruh huwa - and 0h is explicit that a stem stays one unit even when it contains a quotation, so neither the verse nor the reference surat al-Qadr 4 is split off. Same at @255-@265, where the stem contains a reported saying (mata al-yawma sayyid al-muslimin) before fa-man huwa, and at @380-@392 which quotes Q 58:1. Line 14 is the mirror case - there the FOUR options are themselves Quranic phrases (sabbih isma rabbika al-ala / al-hamdu li-llah rabb al-alamin / iqra bi-smi rabbika alladhi khalaq / idha jaa nasr allah wa-l-fath) and each stays whole, including the internal wa of wa-l-fath (I5). Line 11 has options of very unequal length (al-sariqa / al-baghda / al-tanabuz bi-l-alqab / qadhf al-muhsanat al-muminat al-ghafilat, one to four tokens) and the four-count is what fixes them.
